raw_record.question_text: Jeff rotates spinners $P$, $Q$, and $R$ and adds the resulting numbers. What is the probability that his sum is an odd number?

method.method_draft: First inspect the image: spinner P is divided into three equal sectors labeled 1, 2, and 3; spinner Q is divided into four equal sectors labeled 2, 4, 8, and 6; spinner R is divided into six equal sectors labeled 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, and 11. From the text, Jeff spins P, Q, and R once and adds the three resulting numbers, and we need the probability the sum is odd. Use parity: every Q outcome is even, every R outcome is odd, so Q+R is always odd. Therefore the total P+Q+R is odd exactly when P is even. On P, only the sector labeled 2 is even, so the probability is 1 out of 3 equal sectors, giving 1/3.
